current: … और यह किस पर अमल करेगा, यह इसका मालिक तय करता है।
proposed: … और यह किस पर अमल करेगा, यह इसका स्वामी तय करता है।
reason: One term, two spellings: this namespace renders the owner relationship as «स्वामी» in members.role.owner («स्वामी») and twice in the v3 consent note («अपने स्वामी की सहमति», «उसका स्वामी»), then as «मालिक» in the chief-of-staff intro. The role chip and the consent note are what the reader meets first; hi.md's «prefer common Hindi words» does not separate them, so the drift is the defect regardless of which form is chosen — this proposal moves one key instead of three.
